name: mailgrant-mcp
summary: Connect an OpenClaw agent to a self-hosted mailgrant gateway over MCP, with only the mailboxes and scopes its token grants.
description: A thin stdio<->HTTP bridge to a running mailgrant instance's MCP endpoint (/mcp). The agent sees only the tools its token's scopes allow: whoami, mailboxes, inbox, list_folders, list_messages, search, get_message (read); mark_seen (mark); delete_message (delete, moves to trash); send (send). mailgrant is self-hosted — see https://github.com/lucasmaffei/mailgrant.

MAILGRANT_URL.description: Base URL of your mailgrant instance, e.g. https://mail-mcp.example.com (the bridge appends /mcp).

url.description: Base URL of your mailgrant instance (the bridge appends /mcp).
